items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is increasingly being used to both launch and defend against cyber attacks, making threats faster and harder to detect. Separately, a zero-day vulnerability in Cisco equipment has been flagged, relating to weak authentication on API access points — organisations using Cisco products should check with their IT teams about applying any available patches promptly.

On the scam front, Australia's ScamWatch continues to track active scam alerts, and a new international anti-scam alliance including Japan's Global Signal Exchange is working to disrupt scam networks globally — a positive step for Australians targeted by overseas-based scammers.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected message urging urgent action — even if it looks official — pause and verify directly with the organisation before clicking any links.

featured.title: Databricks AI helping telcos prevent churn, predict fraud
featured.summary: By linking customer, network and operational data, telcos can spot churn and fraud sooner, while also speeding service and support decisions…
